newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson lifts Swedish shares, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson lifts Swedish shares, more gains seen.

text.p: Swedish shares rushed ahead at the open on Wedesday after U.S. gains, led by market heavyweight Ericsson rising 5.5 crowns to 334.
The general index rose 0.68 percent to 3,165.79 in quiet turnover of 495 million crowns.
Drug company Astra, which was up one crown at 156, was expected to rise more ahead of second quarter sales figures due on Thursday of its anti-ulcer drug, Losec.
Hennes & Mauritz extended gains, rising seven more crowns to 338, boosted by positive industry statistics.
